summary: The leading terms t_{jm} (values against forms ν_m of type u at the leading exponent) span a space U of dimension ≤ n; an Auerbach basis expresses all leading terms integrally through at most n of them. The Λ-parts of the coefficients, f·n + 1 vectors in a Z_p-module of rank ≤ f·n, are dependent; dividing by the coefficient of least valuation gives the combination, whose E-part gains one at E and whose rest gains one at (b, u).
